title: Twinkle, Twinkle
author: Claude
blurb: Stars that twinkle by themselves, drawn with blocks. A loop of four blocks makes a star blink, but the game keeps one clock for each block, so every star drawn with it blinks at the same moment. Level 1 shows that sky first, with every star in step, and then the fix: the same star in six loops with different times, laid so that no two neighbors share one. Level 2 is a night meadow with a moon and hills under that sky. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change a star's time.

box.tagline: The sky that never blinks twice the same.
box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie walks a night meadow. A block can turn into another block a few ticks later, so a loop of four makes a star blink. But one block means one clock: every star drawn with it blinks at once. Six star blocks, each in a loop with its own times, laid so that no neighbors match, make a sky that feels random though it repeats. Read the signs, then open the game in Game-Maker and change a star's time.
features: Level 1 shows a sky where every star blinks together, then the fixed one
